+

+def test_request_form_context_manager_closes_uploads_on_exception(
+    test_client_factory: TestClientFactory,
+) -> None:
+    async def app(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
+        request = Request(scope, receive)
+        uploads: list[UploadFile] = []
+
+        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
+            async with request.form() as form:
+                uploads = [value for value in form.values() if isinstance(value, UploadFile)]
+                assert all(not upload.file.closed for upload in uploads)
+                raise RuntimeError
+
+        response = JSONResponse({"closed": [upload.file.closed for upload in uploads]})
+        await response(scope, receive, send)
+
+    client = test_client_factory(app)
